_note: Episode 7 keyframes (same method as Episodes 2-6). Indio has NO medallion in every frame. Real people: Rizal is never shown (only a far grave mound); Narcisa and the 1898 group only from behind and far away, inside the lens circle. No body, no blood, no weapons. The lens is always a round golden-edged view. Memory shots of the Lolo are warm sepia. plates/field.jpg and full/intro.jpg are copies from Episode 6; full/tattoo is new and shows exactly five tattoos (no new one in Ep 6 or Ep 7). Shot keys follow the sentence numbers of sentences.json after the 2026-11-12 review; k50 (cart_far) and k51 (indio_calm) are extra keys used only inside montages (shots_fx 'keys'). Review fixes 2026-11-12: the free model could not count or keep two characters on-model, so four frames are hand composites made with OpenCV from generated parts (no extra generation): full/tattoo (the try with four evenly spaced diamonds, the squashed fourth repainted and a fifth copied from the second: exactly five), full/datus (six separate sleeping-datu medallions from one generation, each used twice in a twelve-point ring over plates/cave_star: exactly twelve), full/walk_away and full/sit_wait (chars/pair_walk_white.jpg and chars/pair_sit_white.jpg, generated from the walk_away/sit_wait prompts on white, cut out and placed on plates/village_road and plates/sunset_wall). Do not --redo those four names unless the composites are rebuilt the same way.
